page.layout: One page: a central block of text (dedication lines, then a short verse block, then a printer's imprint at the foot). Large mirrored lines at the top and bottom are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. Library stamps and the shelf mark are excluded.

page.notes: Very low legibility: the scan is faded and the central lines are largely unreadable, so most lines are marked illegible or [?] rather than guessed. The large upside-down "AMARCO / BYMILLERO TIC V / RINO EMISSVS" at the top and the mirrored imprint at the bottom are show-through from the reverse side and were left out. The lines of the central block are the only printed text on this side that is partly readable. The stamps (ELBLASKA BIBLIOTEKA, the cancelled university stamp, and the handwritten shelf mark "Ob. 6. ii. 3069") are excluded. The "Dum Conuersa" line is a best reading and is doubtful. Recheck against a higher-resolution or colour scan.
